label: At D1, high after reaching S1, low after reaching S2, lowest after rewarded S2.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * (prev_reward == 1)
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * ep_dec
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 25 varies beyond timing almost only at D1, where it encodes the state reached on the previous trial: about +0.16 after S1 vs -0.12 after S2 (relative to the window-start case), with an extra drop after a rewarded S2 visit (reward lowers it a little after S1 too). The previous choice and common/rare transition matter little; GO and D2 residuals are small (GO slightly lower after reward). The free fit adds episode-progress scaling of the state effect (it grows late in the episode, when the gate overall drops), a small GO reward term, and belief_lo at D1, gaining about 0.03 R^2. No future, hidden or model-output variables used.

issues: The S2-specific reward term barely beats a generic D1 reward term (test 0.695 vs 0.693 with (phase==D1)*(prev_reward==1)). Reward lowers the gate after S1 as well (residuals: a1 S1 r +0.136 vs a1 S1 u +0.172; a2 S1 r +0.109 vs a2 S1 u +0.15), so 'lowest after rewarded S2' is true, but the reward effect is not specific to S2.

Misses shows a systematic error late in the episode: in trials 95-99, after runs of rewarded S2 visits, D1 values are about 0.23 against a prediction of about 0.37, so the gate drops more than the model allows. Adding ep_dec interactions did not help as a short form (0.610 and 0.687 on test).

Also under-modeled: rewarded S2 after a rare transition (D1 after a1 S2 r, -0.061 over-predicted) and a small GO effect after unrewarded trials (+0.03 to +0.04). Rare-transition terms did not improve the short form (0.680, 0.677, 0.694 on test).

Remaining gap: the short form scores 0.695 on test, against 0.74 for the last-trial table and an observed ceiling of 0.77. No variant I tried beat the recorded short form, and none of its terms are disguised curve fitting.
